info.name: model-failover e2e (response-path retry + additionalProviders reuse)
info.description: End-to-end suite for the model-failover policy - response-path retry mechanism, plus provider: reuse of an LlmProxy's own already-configured additionalProviders (auth + template, never re-typed on the policy itself). Run via run-e2e.sh, not directly.

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mf-poc-provider
spec:
  displayName: Model Failover POC Provider
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /mf-poc-provider/latest
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:9711
  policies:
    - name: model-failover
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            statusCodes: [500]
            suspendDuration: 10s
            requestTimeout: 5s
            targets:
              - model: gpt-4o
                fallbacks:
                  - model: gpt-4o-mini
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

item.name: 04 - LlmProvider: Register mf-poc-chain-test (same-provider url overrides via upstreamDefinitions)

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mf-poc-chain-test
spec:
  displayName: Model Failover POC Chain Test
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /mf-poc-chain-test/latest
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:9711
  upstreamDefinitions:
    - name: backend-b
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9712
    - name: backend-c
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9713
    - name: backend-dead
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9799
  policies:
    - name: model-failover
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            statusCodes: [500, 502, 503, 504]
            # 502/503/504 included because a self-redial to an unreachable fallback (see
            # gpt-4o-neterr below) is dialed by Envoy itself, which returns ITS OWN
            # gateway-error status for a failed upstream connection - not a Go-level
            # network error this policy would otherwise catch unconditionally.
            suspendDuration: 10s
            targets:
              - model: gpt-4o-chain
                fallbacks:
                  - model: gpt-4o-chain-b
                    upstreamDefinition: backend-b
                  - model: gpt-4o-chain-c
                    upstreamDefinition: backend-c
              - model: gpt-4o-neterr
                fallbacks:
                  - model: gpt-4o-neterr-dead
                    upstreamDefinition: backend-dead
                  - model: gpt-4o-neterr-b
                    upstreamDefinition: backend-b
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mf-poc-unwired-provider
spec:
  displayName: Model Failover Unwired Provider Test
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /mf-poc-unwired-provider/latest
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:9711

      version: v0

          methods: [POST]
          params:

              # provider here is a MATCH qualifier, not a redirect (see
              # model_failover.go's package doc) - this target only ever
              # applies to a primary request whose OWN x-provider header
              # equals anthropic-backup. No selector policy is attached to
              # this plain LlmProvider, so a genuine client request never
              # carries that header for real routing purposes; with no
              # provider-agnostic (model, "") catch-all declared either, a
              # primary failure here has nothing to match against at all.
              - model: claude-3-5-sonnet

                fallbacks:
                  - model: claude-3-5-sonnet-retry
  accessControl:

item.name: 13 - LlmProxy: Register base provider + proxy (additionalProviders + model-failover)

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: mf-poc-proxy-provider
spec:
  displayName: Model Failover POC Proxy Base Provider
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /mf-poc-proxy-provider/latest
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:9715
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProxy
metadata:
  name: mf-poc-proxy
spec:
  displayName: Model Failover POC Proxy
  version: v1.0
  context: /mf-poc-proxy
  provider:
    id: mf-poc-proxy-provider
  additionalProviders:
    - id: anthropic-provider
      as: anthropic-backup
      auth:
        type: api-key
        header: x-api-key
        value: anthropic-static-key
      transformer:
        type: openai-to-anthropic-transformer
        version: v0
        params: {}
        # No static 'model' param: openai-to-anthropic-transformer now resolves
        # the model from the request body first (falling back to a configured
        # one only when the request doesn't carry it) - so each target/fallback
        # below reaches Anthropic with its OWN declared model, not a single
        # provider-wide override.
  policies:
    # llm-header-router reads x-provider (the header model-failover sets on a
    # provider-crossing self-redial) and publishes SharedContext.Metadata
    # ["selected_provider"], which gateway-controller's own
    # additionalProviders-conditional auth/transformer policies key off of.
    # Without this attached, a provider reference on model-failover silently
    # reaches the proxy's own default upstream unchanged (see scenario 11).
    - name: llm-header-router
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            mappings:
              - headerValue: anthropic-backup
                provider: anthropic-backup
    - name: model-failover
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            statusCodes: [500]
            targets:
              # Fallback-level provider: the primary attempt is untouched (dials
              # mf-poc-proxy-provider as normal); only a FAILURE triggers the
              # response-path retry against the anthropic-backup loopback.
              - model: gpt-4o
                fallbacks:
                  - model: claude-3-5-sonnet
                    provider: anthropic-backup
              # Provider-disambiguated targets: the SAME model name, matched
              # against which provider the PRIMARY request actually went to -
              # its own x-provider header (see groupByModel/requestedProvider
              # in model_failover.go), never anything this policy redirects.
              # No pre-dial redirect of any kind: the primary always dials
              # whatever llm-header-router/default routing already resolved
              # for it; only a genuine FAILURE triggers either chain below.
              - model: dual-provider-model
                provider: anthropic-backup
                fallbacks:
                  # Bare reuse: replays the client's own original headers,
                  # which already carry x-provider: anthropic-backup (the
                  # CLIENT set it, not model-failover), so the redial
                  # naturally reaches anthropic-backup again.
                  - model: dual-provider-model-anthropic-retry
              - model: dual-provider-model
                fallbacks:
                  # Bare reuse again - this (model, "") catch-all only
                  # matches when the primary's own provider didn't match the
                  # target above (absent x-provider, or one no mapping
                  # recognizes), so its primary dialed the proxy's own
                  # default upstream (mf-poc-proxy-provider / backend P);
                  # the redial reaches backend P again the same way.
                  - model: dual-provider-model-default-retry
              # Regression coverage for the fix verified in 16b below: this
              # fallback's own 'model' must reach Anthropic unmodified. Uses a
              # deliberately distinct model name so a pass can't be a
              # coincidence (e.g. matching some other target's model).
              - model: gpt-4o-mini
                fallbacks:
                  - model: claude-3-opus-should-be-used
                    provider: anthropic-backup
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]
